title: Coefficient 7/2 with a sharper paired-input reduction and exact finite audit

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. For actual length N, choose k as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3; read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. claims: Supplemental local reduction theorem (not a stronger asymptotic score): use the full-B2 circuit/affine-system representation and injective matching-quadratic parameter map of elimination.md, with M independent parameters, q disjoint pairs, a=M-q, s charged rows plus gates, and H=2s+3q+sum of unpaired-parameter weights (0 for degree zero, 6 for degree one, 7 for degree at least two). Assume the preliminary cases 1-5 of that file are absent: in particular D1-D4 are unavailable, no AND on parameters has an isolated unpaired input, and paired parameters have exactly one child and occur in no affine row. Suppose a non-output AND-type gate G has distinct parameter parents p,w, where p is paired with h, w is unpaired of degree at least two, and h has unique child B_h distinct from G. If B_h is a child of G, there is a legal restriction and rerouting deleting at least G and B_h, preserving the represented restricted function and injectivity, with Delta a=0 and Delta H<=0. Otherwise there is such a reduction deleting at least G, B_h and one distinct child D of G, with Delta a=-1 and Delta H<=-15. Degrees count distinct child rows and gates, not output references. The reductions and the claimed potential changes hold under arbitrary fanout and shared descendants, with each charged deletion counted once; other degenerate objects may remain charged until a later preliminary reduction. This supplements case 6 only and does not claim a leading coefficient above 7/2.

experiments.purpose: Supplementary exact checks of local B2 identities, quadratic bijection, potential arithmetic, prime-degree irreducibility, weighted block isolation and executable family evaluation. These bounded checks do not establish universal coverage or the asymptotic theorem.
